scenarios.title: Duplicate task submission
scenarios.given: Two requests use the same idempotency key and body
scenarios.when: They race or the first response is lost
scenarios.then: One task and one workflow exist; both callers obtain the same identity

scenarios.title: Conflicting idempotency payload
scenarios.given: A key already has an accepted request
scenarios.when: The caller changes the body under that key
scenarios.then: 409 is returned and no second side effect occurs

scenarios.title: Launch crash recovery
scenarios.given: Task and outbox are committed
scenarios.when: Dispatcher dies after Temporal start but before marking dispatch
scenarios.then: Restart attaches to the same Workflow ID and clears the outbox

scenarios.title: Projection ordering
scenarios.given: Projection sequence 12 is stored
scenarios.when: Sequence 11 or duplicate 12 arrives
scenarios.then: Older content cannot overwrite state; conflicting duplicate is rejected

scenarios.title: Cross-organization access
scenarios.given: Two organizations own tasks/artifacts
scenarios.when: A caller supplies another organization's IDs
scenarios.then: API, artifact access and tenant-qualified database writes deny access

scenarios.title: Artifact atomic finalization
scenarios.given: Object upload or DB finalization is interrupted
scenarios.when: A dependent gate attempts to read the object
scenarios.then: Only finalized hash-verified artifacts are accepted; orphan is swept

scenarios.title: Workflow command race
scenarios.given: A new spec revision races with an approval or result
scenarios.when: Both commands are processed
scenarios.then: Only current bindings advance; stale subject is rejected with reason

scenarios.title: Continue-As-New dedupe
scenarios.given: A command is applied before workflow rollover
scenarios.when: Its delivery is retried in the new run
scenarios.then: It is not applied again and state/cursors/budget remain correct

scenarios.title: Worker version replay
scenarios.given: A representative active history uses an older build
scenarios.when: New workers are deployed and histories replayed
scenarios.then: No nondeterminism; old workflows retain compatible execution

scenarios.title: Duplicate run start
scenarios.given: Two controllers receive the same run and hash
scenarios.when: Both reconcile/create execution
scenarios.then: One accepted allocation/writer launches; duplicate attaches or exits

scenarios.title: Run identity conflict
scenarios.given: A run ID exists with input hash A
scenarios.when: A request supplies hash B
scenarios.then: Conflict is returned without altering or attaching incompatible work

scenarios.title: Stale live writer
scenarios.given: A lease expires while the old process still runs
scenarios.when: Replacement is requested
scenarios.then: Old remote writes are fenced; volume reuse requires proven quiescence or isolated restore

scenarios.title: Dirty checkpoint restore
scenarios.given: Workspace has binary edits, staged/unstaged changes, deletion and untracked files
scenarios.when: Pod is lost after checkpoint acknowledgement
scenarios.then: Clean allocation reproduces declared index/source hashes without secrets

scenarios.title: Unacknowledged checkpoint
scenarios.given: Upload succeeds but manifest finalization fails
scenarios.when: Runner/pod dies
scenarios.then: Last acknowledged checkpoint remains authoritative and no nonexistent recovery is promised

scenarios.title: Process cancellation
scenarios.given: A harness launches a long-lived child process
scenarios.when: Task is cancelled
scenarios.then: Child tree stops within profile bound; side effects reconcile and cleanup is recorded

scenarios.title: Missing native session
scenarios.given: Source/handoff exist but native conversation is absent
scenarios.when: Task resumes or changes harness
scenarios.then: Fresh execution uses the portable checkpoint and records fallback

scenarios.title: Cross-harness continuation
scenarios.given: Harness A starts a feature and persists source/plan
scenarios.when: Harness B resumes in a clean allocation
scenarios.then: Same accepted criteria pass without A's private conversation state

scenarios.title: Malformed agent output
scenarios.given: Harness produces invalid or unsupported result JSON
scenarios.when: Factory validates the output
scenarios.then: No gate advances; bounded format repair consumes declared budget

scenarios.title: Unauthorized tool request
scenarios.given: An author requests publishing or production credentials
scenarios.when: Capability proxy evaluates the call
scenarios.then: Call is denied and audited; prompt text cannot grant authority

scenarios.title: Valid bug repair
scenarios.given: Baseline has a reproducible contract violation
scenarios.when: Reviewed regression fails as intended, locks and passes on candidate
scenarios.then: Bug completes with identical canonical package and comparable environment evidence

scenarios.title: False baseline red
scenarios.given: Baseline fails due to setup or a missing dependency
scenarios.when: Bug workflow attempts to lock/advance
scenarios.then: Red gate fails or is inconclusive; diagnosis/setup is revisited

scenarios.title: Canonical test tampering
scenarios.given: Implementer changes its test copy or verification configuration
scenarios.when: Independent verifier runs
scenarios.then: Canonical digest remains unchanged; bypass attempt cannot create success

scenarios.title: Empty or skipped suite
scenarios.given: Candidate causes no test discovery or unexpected skipped cases
scenarios.when: Runner exits zero
scenarios.then: Outcome verification fails or is inconclusive with explicit counts

scenarios.title: Source binding changes
scenarios.given: Candidate C has a passing gate
scenarios.when: Candidate C2 or required recipe changes
scenarios.then: C's result is superseded and cannot approve C2

scenarios.title: Feature acceptance
scenarios.given: A feature has user, error and permission criteria
scenarios.when: Candidate omits one required scenario
scenarios.then: Task remains incomplete/failed despite author completion

scenarios.title: Refactor equivalence
scenarios.given: Refactor has baseline invariants and structural objective
scenarios.when: Behavior changes or structural objective is absent
scenarios.then: Verification/review blocks and routes to the correct stage

scenarios.title: Maintenance matrix
scenarios.given: Dependency upgrade claims compatibility with several consumers
scenarios.when: One supported consumer fails after install/build succeeds
scenarios.then: Compatibility gate blocks delivery without shrinking the matrix

scenarios.title: Performance comparison
scenarios.given: Benchmark protocol is frozen
scenarios.when: Candidate has one fast trial but fails target variability or correctness
scenarios.then: No performance success; measurement or implementation rework occurs

scenarios.title: Platform recovery
scenarios.given: Migration changes persistent format
scenarios.when: Mixed-version rehearsal or recovery fails
scenarios.then: Production application stays blocked; design/implementation is revisited

scenarios.title: Documentation evidence
scenarios.given: Document has versioned source claims and runnable examples
scenarios.when: A claim/example is unsupported
scenarios.then: Document validation returns to source/draft; no unrelated runtime test is forced

scenarios.title: Investigation closure
scenarios.given: Question and evidence boundary are accepted
scenarios.when: Evidence report accurately records uncertainty and is reviewed
scenarios.then: Task can succeed as a report without PR/deployment or fabricated certainty

scenarios.title: Wrong service blamed
scenarios.given: Downstream error was caused by invalid upstream input
scenarios.when: Discovery compares trace boundaries and contracts
scenarios.then: Diagnosis identifies evidence-supported component(s), not the last erroring API

scenarios.title: Risk escalation
scenarios.given: A narrow ticket produces a sensitive/API/data change
scenarios.when: Policy evaluates the actual diff
scenarios.then: Enhanced relevant gates are added; small diff cannot bypass them

scenarios.title: Budget concurrency
scenarios.given: Two child stages contend for the remaining parent allowance
scenarios.when: Both reserve concurrently
scenarios.then: Reservations cannot oversubscribe allowance; unmet work never becomes success

scenarios.title: Skeptical review dispute
scenarios.given: A blocking finding is challenged with evidence
scenarios.when: Rebuttal/adjudication limit is reached
scenarios.then: Recorded decision or incomplete outcome; no endless review loop or silent dismissal

scenarios.title: PR create timeout
scenarios.given: Provider creates PR but response is lost
scenarios.when: Publication retries
scenarios.then: Same PR is found/reconciled using stable identity; no duplicate

scenarios.title: Moving target branch
scenarios.given: Candidate passed against old target head
scenarios.when: Target advances before merge
scenarios.then: New composition is evaluated and expected revisions enforced

scenarios.title: Human edits task branch
scenarios.given: Remote branch head differs from expected
scenarios.when: Publisher attempts update
scenarios.then: Human work is preserved and explicit reconciliation is required

scenarios.title: Deployment uncertain success
scenarios.given: Provider creates environment then times out
scenarios.when: Environment workflow recovers
scenarios.then: Lookup attaches to the existing resource or records unknown; no blind duplicate

scenarios.title: Unreconcilable provider
scenarios.given: Tool has neither safe dedupe nor authoritative lookup
scenarios.when: Submit outcome becomes uncertain
scenarios.then: Automatic resubmission is disabled and operator action is explicit

scenarios.title: Ready is not verified
scenarios.given: Services are healthy but behavior is wrong
scenarios.when: Preview checks execute
scenarios.then: Readiness can pass while behavior gate fails; task cannot claim verified delivery

scenarios.title: Environment state equivalence
scenarios.given: Bug baseline and candidate use mutable fixtures
scenarios.when: Comparison runs are prepared
scenarios.then: State is reinitialized/pinned and relevant differences recorded

scenarios.title: Cleanup after task loss
scenarios.given: Task/workflow is cancelled or terminated
scenarios.when: Preview/PVC expires
scenarios.then: Independent sweeper reconciles owned resources and records cleanup failure if needed

scenarios.title: Stale production approval
scenarios.given: Approval names release C and environment E
scenarios.when: Candidate/policy/authority changes before apply
scenarios.then: Release is denied until current requirements are satisfied

scenarios.title: Observed release mismatch
scenarios.given: Deployment returns success but target has another image
scenarios.when: Postdeploy inventory/checks run
scenarios.then: Mismatch blocks success and starts reconciliation

scenarios.title: Multi-repository integration
scenarios.given: Children pass independently on incompatible API versions
scenarios.when: Parent validates exact release composition
scenarios.then: Parent blocks and coordinates contract/integration rework

scenarios.title: Knowledge provenance
scenarios.given: Agent proposes a confident global lesson without supporting evidence
scenarios.when: Knowledge workflow processes it
scenarios.then: It remains proposed/disputed and cannot alter policy or verified runbook facts

scenarios.title: Registry import failure
scenarios.given: Last valid app profile exists
scenarios.when: New source has invalid/unresolved protected fields
scenarios.then: Import errors surface; last valid version remains and task snapshots do not drift

scenarios.title: Artifact content isolation
scenarios.given: An uploaded report contains active HTML/script
scenarios.when: User opens/downloads it
scenarios.then: It cannot execute in the authenticated dashboard origin or access credentials

scenarios.title: Backup restore with external effects
scenarios.given: DB backup predates an already-created PR/environment
scenarios.when: Factory is restored
scenarios.then: Admission stays stopped until provider reconciliation prevents duplicate effects

scenarios.title: Capacity fairness
scenarios.given: Incident workload saturates part of the organization quota
scenarios.when: Normal and background tasks queue
scenarios.then: Configured fairness/reservations hold and resource ceilings are enforced

scenarios.title: Event stream resume
scenarios.given: Client disconnects or starts with an expired cursor
scenarios.when: It reconnects
scenarios.then: No duplicate UI application; resumable ordering or explicit snapshot refresh

scenarios.title: Native capability qualification
scenarios.given: An adapter advertises resume/cancel/usage
scenarios.when: Its pinned runtime is exercised
scenarios.then: Only demonstrated capabilities remain enabled; unavailable usage is labeled

scenarios.title: End-to-end audit
scenarios.given: A report/PR/release is delivered
scenarios.when: Operator exports its outcome bundle
scenarios.then: Exact source, policy, criteria, evidence, decisions and provider handles are traceable; ReviewMode and AI-reviewed — no human review marker accompany ai_only outcomes with AI and voluntary human decisions separate

scenarios.title: Flaky required gate
scenarios.given: Identical checks alternate pass/fail
scenarios.when: Diagnostic repetition runs
scenarios.then: All attempts retained; isolated pass cannot silently produce success

scenarios.title: Network and credential boundary
scenarios.given: Candidate code attempts metadata/control-plane/other-task access
scenarios.when: Execution profile is enforced on the real cluster
scenarios.then: Access is denied and qualified isolation limits are documented

scenarios.title: Prompt/context contamination
scenarios.given: Reviewer starts after author left native memory/scratch instructions
scenarios.when: Fresh role context is assembled
scenarios.then: Only permitted canonical inputs and labeled rationale appear

scenarios.title: Migrations across worker versions
scenarios.given: Old workflows remain active during DB/schema upgrade
scenarios.when: Expand/backfill/contract rollout proceeds
scenarios.then: Old and new readers work until safe retirement and histories replay

scenarios.title: Production mitigation
scenarios.given: Qualified rollout breaches predeclared health/data criteria
scenarios.when: Delivery executes recovery policy
scenarios.then: Promotion stops and actual mitigation/recovery state is verified

scenarios.title: Acceptance corpus
scenarios.given: All eight types, three journeys and greenfield new-repository/monorepo negative fixtures are configured
scenarios.when: Release candidate executes representative corpus
scenarios.then: Required outcomes and false-success/isolation rules pass with durable reports

scenarios.title: Three distinct journey routes
scenarios.given: New-app feature and existing-app feature/bug requests are admitted
scenarios.when: The planner resolves target context and intent
scenarios.then: greenfield, existing_feature and bug_fix templates respectively are pinned; invalid combinations and missing context are rejected

scenarios.title: Draft before repository
scenarios.given: No application repository or execution profile exists
scenarios.when: An authorized caller creates a draft and greenfield task
scenarios.then: Immutable intent and stable application identity are stored without fake Git/profile values; existing-target admission rejects the draft

scenarios.title: Real base before worktree
scenarios.given: A new repository task has an accepted bootstrap plan
scenarios.when: Initialization completes or a runner requests allocation too early
scenarios.then: Only a durable receipt with a retrievable real base and approved setup profile permits allocation; empty or zero OIDs are rejected

scenarios.title: Uncertain repository creation
scenarios.given: Create or initialize succeeds remotely but its reply is lost
scenarios.when: Activity retries or a replacement controller reconciles
scenarios.then: Stable identities recover the same resource/commit; unverifiable outcomes retain the claim at needs_operator without a second create

scenarios.title: Greenfield in a monorepo
scenarios.given: A new service targets an existing repository/subpath
scenarios.when: The greenfield bootstrap and scaffold run
scenarios.then: No remote repository or initial default-branch commit is created; the existing real base and path scope are enforced including shared-file review

scenarios.title: Scaffold is not product success
scenarios.given: Greenfield setup/build/health checks pass but an accepted user journey fails
scenarios.when: The workflow evaluates completion
scenarios.then: Foundation readiness stays distinct; parent success is blocked and the affected slice/design is revisited

scenarios.title: Existing feature preserves obligations
scenarios.given: A feature has new criteria and existing consumers
scenarios.when: Independent acceptance and compatibility execute
scenarios.then: No universal intentional-red requirement is imposed; a broken existing contract blocks completion and routes to implementation/design

scenarios.title: Bug gates survive mode changes
scenarios.given: A bug requests fast or one-invocation execution
scenarios.when: The plan is compiled and a candidate appears green
scenarios.then: Intended baseline red and the same reviewed locked package remain mandatory; missing evidence returns to diagnosis/oracle or incomplete

scenarios.title: Pinned journey survives restart
scenarios.given: An accepted plan uses a specific template artifact
scenarios.when: Configuration upgrades and Continue-As-New occur
scenarios.then: The original template remains bound; adoption of a new version needs explicit migration and reevaluation

scenarios.title: Target reclassification invalidates evidence
scenarios.given: Discovery finds a materially different target boundary
scenarios.when: An authorized revised specification is applied
scenarios.then: New context/template/plan bindings invalidate affected evidence; acquired bootstrap effects forbid silent primary-target replacement

scenarios.title: Greenfield parent composition
scenarios.given: Foundation and child tasks pass on separate candidates
scenarios.when: The parent integrates the required children
scenarios.then: Only passing parent criteria on the exact integrated composition permit completion; incompatible children return to affected work with shared budgets

scenarios.title: Cancel retains created repository
scenarios.given: A greenfield task owns a newly created repository or uncertain creation
scenarios.when: Cancellation and reconciliation execute
scenarios.then: External repositories remain owned with recorded disposition; unknown effects retain the claim and are not deleted as preview cleanup

scenarios.title: Glanceable distinct journeys
scenarios.given: Users have greenfield, feature and bug tasks with mixed states
scenarios.when: They inspect intake and the task list then request details
scenarios.then: Three entry choices and journey-specific milestones show the current blocker/action; foundation cannot look complete and evidence expands accessibly

scenarios.title: Draft revision and claim races
scenarios.given: Two callers race revisions or task admission against one draft
scenarios.when: Transactions apply under current authorization
scenarios.then: Stale revision receives 412, conflicting active claim receives 409, cross-tenant/namespace access is denied and idempotent retries attach to one result

scenarios.title: Interview before architecture
scenarios.given: A human-mode vague greenfield request has provisional criteria and no repository choice
scenarios.when: The workflow starts under any assurance mode
scenarios.then: Only discovery/interview work proceeds; design/bootstrap/implementation wait for the exact human-confirmed brief and approved repository intent is required before bootstrap

scenarios.title: Contradictory stakeholder intent
scenarios.given: Two authorized stakeholders give incompatible scope or behavior requirements
scenarios.when: The interviewer and fresh reviewer analyze the brief
scenarios.then: The contradiction remains visible and blocks confirmation until its accountable human owner resolves it with evidence

scenarios.title: Unknown is not an answer
scenarios.given: A human cannot answer a question that materially changes the product
scenarios.when: The answer is unknown or deferred
scenarios.then: The system records a blocking issue and seeks evidence/clarification without inventing a requirement or assuming agreement

scenarios.title: Exact human intent authority
scenarios.given: A human-mode brief is ready for confirmation
scenarios.when: An agent claims approval, a service identity responds or a human submits an old subject hash
scenarios.then: All are rejected; every required owner must approve the same current subject after independent review, with partial approval unable to satisfy intent_aligned

scenarios.title: Intent change and approval reuse
scenarios.given: Human-confirmed intent has dependent design and source evidence
scenarios.when: Scope materially changes or an unchanged operation merely retries
scenarios.then: Changed intent reopens affected topics and invalidates dependent work; an unchanged valid subject reuses the applied decision without another human click

scenarios.title: Interview resume and answer race
scenarios.given: An interview waits with persisted questions and answer commands
scenarios.when: Workers restart, Continue-As-New occurs, harness changes or two answers race
scenarios.then: Artifacts preserve continuity and unchanged questions; duplicate commands apply once and stale revisions cannot overwrite current answers

scenarios.title: Interview timeout cannot approve
scenarios.given: In human mode the human has not confirmed intent
scenarios.when: Round count, task deadline, budget ceiling or one-invocation allowance is reached
scenarios.then: Progress is preserved with an explicit incomplete/waiting outcome; no timeout, confidence score or mode bypasses confirmation and no runner is held for human wait

scenarios.title: Bounded explicit assumptions
scenarios.given: A brief includes unresolved assumptions
scenarios.when: The system evaluates readiness and owner confirmation
scenarios.then: Only explicit low-impact reversible assumptions with owner, validation plan and human acceptance can remain; material uncertainty still blocks

scenarios.title: Focused question and read-back UI
scenarios.given: A busy user has an unfinished greenfield interview
scenarios.when: They answer, leave, resume, correct the brief and confirm
scenarios.then: One to three focused questions, visible blockers and expandable context preserve progress; exact-version confirmation is never preselected or automatically submitted

scenarios.title: Skeptical intent review and issue provenance
scenarios.given: An interviewer proposes vague success, omits a prior conflict or marks it nonblocking
scenarios.when: A fresh reviewer and gate evaluator compare the brief with answer/issue history
scenarios.then: Unsupported interpretation and missing issue resolution block alignment; corrections retain human sources and lead to concrete acceptance examples

scenarios.title: Complete engineering packet
scenarios.given: A plan is prepared for peer review
scenarios.when: A required section is missing, incomplete or falsely not applicable
scenarios.then: Review publication/admission is blocked until design, criteria, scenarios, DoD and all applicable engineering coverage are complete

scenarios.title: Acceptance-to-proof traceability
scenarios.given: A plan declares criteria, scenarios and DoD
scenarios.when: A criterion has no scenario, an anchor is dangling or a completion predicate lacks evidence
scenarios.then: Packet validation rejects the gap and returns it to the author before execution

scenarios.title: Independent required peers
scenarios.given: A human-mode complete packet requires a primary and service specialist
scenarios.when: An author/service approves, one peer is missing or assignment coverage is insufficient
scenarios.then: No peer gate passes; each required qualified independent human must approve the same current subject with assigned scope coverage

scenarios.title: Material plan revision
scenarios.given: A packet has signed criteria, design and DoD
scenarios.when: An author changes a required scenario, design contract or delivery scope
scenarios.then: A new subject and semantic diff invalidate all required packet approvals and affected dependent work; unchanged retries reuse valid decisions

scenarios.title: One subject across review layers
scenarios.given: The UI shows summary, structured review and full detail
scenarios.when: A material risk exists or underlying content changes without a summary change
scenarios.then: Critical risks/blockers remain visible and source revisions stay aligned; an unchanged summary cannot mask a changed approval subject

scenarios.title: Blocking comment versus approval
scenarios.given: A required peer has a current review request
scenarios.when: A blocking comment, resolution, revised packet and approval race
scenarios.then: The serialized handler preserves authorship and current binding, refuses stale/self-resolved blockers and cannot approve around an unresolved finding

scenarios.title: Planned tests are not results
scenarios.given: A peer approves scenarios and their expected outcomes
scenarios.when: The dashboard renders readiness and completion
scenarios.then: Scenario status stays planned until real independent bound results exist; design sign-off cannot satisfy verification or release gates

scenarios.title: Definition of done matches scope
scenarios.given: A plan targets PR, preview or production with work-specific obligations
scenarios.when: Implementation produces source or an artifact without all required outcomes
scenarios.then: Completion remains incomplete until current DoD evidence exists; PR does not imply deployment and bug/feature/greenfield predicates remain distinct

scenarios.title: Proportionate plan without peer bypass
scenarios.given: A human-mode small task selects fast or one-invocation mode
scenarios.when: The plan compiler builds its reviewable scope
scenarios.then: A concise complete packet with justified applicability is allowed, but missing sections, unknown peers, timeout or mode cannot remove human sign-off

scenarios.title: Review comprehension and resumption
scenarios.given: Representative engineers review a plan with seeded consequential omissions
scenarios.when: They orient, inspect scenarios/DoD, pause, resume and review a material diff
scenarios.then: They can locate the decision, impact, blockers and full evidence without losing subject/focus; qualification measures comprehension and missed risks alongside orientation time, never clicks as approval proof

scenarios.title: Factory tool epoch and role authority
scenarios.given: A server has a current allocation and role grant
scenarios.when: A stale epoch or role-spoofed call arrives
scenarios.then: Reject and audit before work; arguments cannot select another task role or binding

scenarios.title: Submission identity and in-run correction
scenarios.given: A stage has strict role schemas and a proposal receipt
scenarios.when: Malformed output is corrected then proposals are retried
scenarios.then: Correction uses existing budget; identical proposal returns original receipt; conflicting proposal cannot replace it

scenarios.title: Proposal finalisation crash and writer race
scenarios.given: An agent submits while background commands can mutate source
scenarios.when: Supervisor crashes or observes a continuing writer
scenarios.then: No completion before quiescence exact snapshot durable artifacts and current epoch; recovery attaches to receipt

scenarios.title: Factory human request lifecycle
scenarios.given: A role raises a bound question
scenarios.when: Blocking nonblocking and duplicate calls arrive
scenarios.then: Blocking ends needs_input after checkpoint without runner wait; nonblocking records only; authenticated answer enters next context; neither grants authority

scenarios.title: Feedback caps and canonical separation
scenarios.given: A stage can run visible verify
scenarios.when: Calls or time are exhausted or private checks requested
scenarios.then: Enforce caps in code; feedback cannot satisfy gates; holdouts remain inaccessible; hand off or end incomplete

scenarios.title: Supervisor credential boundary
scenarios.given: Harness and supervisor share a network but not credentials
scenarios.when: Candidate tries to read tokens execute in supervisor or call control plane
scenarios.then: Credentials remain unavailable; server checks narrow scope; code runs in credential-free container; unsupported isolation blocks qualification

scenarios.title: Noninteractive Claude pilot and gateway
scenarios.given: Pinned Claude profile runs in restricted pod
scenarios.when: Permission prompt routing failure or orphan subprocess occurs
scenarios.then: Policy allows or denies without interactive wait; scoped gateway handles models; process-tree cancellation and usage precision are proven

scenarios.title: Remote effect wrapper uncertainty
scenarios.given: Deploy succeeds but response is lost
scenarios.when: Wrapper restarts without lookup or conditional resource identity
scenarios.then: Record unknown/needs_operator instead of blind retry; real preview stays disabled until provider guarantees qualify

scenarios.title: Early fault framework
scenarios.given: Durable and provider boundaries gain state transitions
scenarios.when: Crashes run before and after each boundary
scenarios.then: Attach reconcile or explicit unknown preserves operation identity; framework starts M1 and grows with components

scenarios.title: Explicit PR completion policies
scenarios.given: Tasks select pr_created review_completed or merged
scenarios.when: PR opens is reviewed then merged
scenarios.then: Each completes only its accepted predicate on reconciled current head; waits hold no runner or implicit merge authority

scenarios.title: Human review rework and invalidation
scenarios.given: Authorized current-head reviewer requests implementation/design changes
scenarios.when: Bounded review batch is accepted
scenarios.then: Route to correct stage; changed plan is reapproved and changed candidate independently reverified before same-PR expected-head update

scenarios.title: Review cap close and handover
scenarios.given: A task waits for review or merge
scenarios.when: Round/calendar cap owner handover or unmerged close occurs
scenarios.then: Unmet objective ends incomplete with handed_over/abandoned; retries do not double-count and close never means success

scenarios.title: Human branch push reconciliation
scenarios.given: Human changes task branch
scenarios.when: Factory tries to publish
scenarios.then: Reject overwrite; authorized adoption creates fresh bindings/evidence or handover transfers ownership

scenarios.title: Untrusted PR events and stale approval
scenarios.given: Duplicate out-of-order events and malicious comments arrive
scenarios.when: Comment widens scope or approval names earlier head
scenarios.then: Reconcile authorized provider state; comments grant no capabilities and stale approvals cannot finish newer work

scenarios.title: PR wait continuation and terminal follow-up
scenarios.given: Wait crosses Continue-As-New or task already terminal
scenarios.when: Repeated review or later comment arrives
scenarios.then: Persist policy rounds heads receipts and decisions; terminal task stays unchanged and follow-up needs authorized linked task

scenarios.title: Structure outline traceability
scenarios.given: Packet contains components interfaces data and slices
scenarios.when: Slice loses criterion or outline changes behind same summary
scenarios.then: Reject missing mappings; exact-subject diff/sign-off includes outline; independent peer remains mandatory

scenarios.title: Actual-diff risk and sampling
scenarios.given: Fast intake touches auth/unknown coverage or is audit-selected
scenarios.when: Candidate is evaluated or retry occurs
scenarios.then: Escalate before publish; sample receives standard scrutiny; persisted selection cannot be rerolled by agent/retry

scenarios.title: Code-health cohort maturity
scenarios.given: Few recent changes have immature 90-day windows
scenarios.when: Owner reviews churn merge counts architectural findings and defects
scenarios.then: Show denominators sources attribution uncertainty and maturity; sparse evidence cannot justify relaxation or causal quality

scenarios.title: Authorized modes and degradation
scenarios.given: Qualified cohort has policy and degradation thresholds
scenarios.when: Metrics degrade or relaxation is proposed
scenarios.then: Record preauthorized tightening and reevaluate affected work; relaxation requires qualified human decision; mandatory floors remain

scenarios.title: Behavior release invalidates qualification
scenarios.given: Prompt model tool or evaluator changes
scenarios.when: Release seeks prior autonomy
scenarios.then: Version complete configuration and rerun held-out corpus/canaries; old cohort trust does not transfer silently

scenarios.title: Assertion failure-signature parsing
scenarios.given: Baseline has pinned parser and intended matcher
scenarios.when: Assertion compile setup discovery network timeout failures occur
scenarios.then: Only named intended assertion with required counts proves red; unknown is inconclusive and raw logs retained

scenarios.title: Reviewed baseline shim
scenarios.given: Test needs compatibility shim
scenarios.when: Shim contains repair or differs on baseline/candidate
scenarios.then: Reject it; only reviewed immutable nonrepair shim enters lock; unsupported interface needs external reproduction/investigation

scenarios.title: Unreproduced fix proposal

scenarios.when: Configured signal windows sample floors backlog or severity thresholds are crossed
scenarios.then: All signals enter the ledger with denominators attribution and evidence; authorized rules automatically tighten to human and manual merge and re-evaluate in-flight work before effects

scenarios.title: Emergency stop mode loss
scenarios.given: ai_only work is active or paused with a pending merge
scenarios.when: Organization emergency stop activates then is cleared
scenarios.then: Admission publication and merge are fenced and application returns to human/manual merge; clearing does not restore ai_only; affected nonterminal work is re-evaluated before any effect

scenarios.title: Review mode UI and API
scenarios.given: Human and ai_only applications and tasks coexist
scenarios.when: Users list filter inspect review or export them
scenarios.then: ReviewMode filters and markers agree with current authority; application shows status scope expiry and audit backlog; AI identity is never shown as human and hidden sample selection is unavailable to agents; The runtime implementation MUST pass an adversarial negative corpus covering provenance laundering; scope and embargo/hotfix/production; identity and fork; chronology; nested outputs; empty refs; stale qualification; exported views overriding the trusted task snapshot; nested bundles reviving revoked or stopped authority; provider review observations presented as human approval; production mitigation without human release; release decisions without an identified decider, with every expected-reject case rejected and every expected-accept control passing. Static reference predicates do not prove runtime enforcement.

scenarios.title: Review persistence and isolation
scenarios.given: Mode decisions transitions AI decisions and audit rows exist
scenarios.when: Cross-org requests writes retries and migrations run
scenarios.then: Tenant-qualified references forced RLS append-only grants immutable identities and hidden audit-selection access hold; AI records cannot enter human approvals; old rows and histories retain meaning

scenarios.title: Versioned review behavior
scenarios.given: Human template histories and frozen tools exist
scenarios.when: ai-review/1.0 is enabled or an old worker encounters it
scenarios.then: Compatible readers and explicit migrations precede enablement; greenfield 5.0.0 and existing_feature/bug_fix 4.0.0 pin new semantics; old templates remain human and tools 1.2.0 plus frozen 1.0/1.1 are unchanged; unknown profile fails closed

scenarios.title: Organization facts close enablement
scenarios.given: INT-18 lacks opted apps dev identity branch protection families corpus audit or degradation values
scenarios.when: An operator tries to establish ai_only
scenarios.then: Pre-repository review is blocked until draft application organization repository-intent policy intended dev branch scoped identity and all qualification/audit/degradation facts are recorded with both owners; AI PR review and merge additionally require the verified concrete repository binding after creation effective before every retained PR vote; real provider and panel effectiveness remain not yet proven by static fixtures

scenarios.title: Mode transition merge race
scenarios.given: Approval and preview passed but mode loss races a provider merge
scenarios.when: Controller fences and reconciles the operation
scenarios.then: A serialized current authority check prevents newly unauthorized effects; already committed provider effects are reconciled honestly and audited without retrying or inventing rollback; pending work requires human review and manual merge

scenarios.title: Design scope selection
scenarios.given: A requester submits feature greenfield or existing refactor performance or platform intent with deliveryScope design
scenarios.when: Admission validates the request
scenarios.then: The design template for that work type and target is pinned with the design budget class; bug maintenance investigation and documentation design requests, prCompletion, a non-design budget class and designSource on a design task are rejected; design remains a delivery scope and no ninth work type exists

scenarios.title: Design graph without implementation
scenarios.given: A design template or compiled design plan is admitted
scenarios.when: The compiler checks its nodes capabilities and gates
scenarios.then: Only intake discovery intent planning peer review render delivery and close stages exist; any execute criteria verify bootstrap scaffold preview merge workspace or environment write or outcome/verification gate is rejected; no runner coding workspace or harness coding stage is allocated

scenarios.title: Design review gates in every tier
scenarios.given: A fast one-invocation or single-runtime design task reaches plan review
scenarios.when: A shortened packet is produced
scenarios.then: scope_accepted architecture_accepted plan_peer_approved and plan_accepted plus intent_aligned for greenfield are still required with every required specialist under ReviewMode; a template or plan omitting any of them is rejected

scenarios.title: Complete packet for a future build
scenarios.given: A design packet is submitted for peer review
scenarios.when: Completeness checks run
scenarios.then: All twelve sections are present; acceptance_tests holds the planned criterion-to-scenario matrix; definition_of_done names the future build evidence; plannedBuildDeliveryScope is explicit; planned scenarios never render as passed

scenarios.title: Deterministic design rendering
scenarios.given: The packet subject is approved
scenarios.when: The render controller produces Markdown
scenarios.then: The rendered digest is reproducible from the exact approved packet and renderer version and carries stable anchors for every section criterion and scenario; a mismatched packet missing anchor or later packet revision blocks delivery

scenarios.title: Design PR delivery
scenarios.given: An application has a configured design-docs/ADR location
scenarios.when: Delivery runs after approval
scenarios.then: The publisher controller commits only rendered files under that subpath and creates one reviewable design PR; delivery_complete passes when that PR exists without waiting for review or merge; merge follows the docs repository rules and the task never merges or acquires merge authority

scenarios.title: Design report fallback and target eligibility
scenarios.given: No design-docs location is configured or the configured target is ineligible
scenarios.when: Delivery is attempted
scenarios.then: Absent configuration produces a classified report artifact; an ineligible classification or confidentiality target blocks for an authorized owner decision and is never downgraded; a report is not used when an eligible location exists

scenarios.title: Honest design outcome
scenarios.given: A design task completes or fails
scenarios.when: The outcome manifest and UI are produced
scenarios.then: design_approved records the exact packet subject approvals delivery target and limitation that nothing is implemented or verified; it never claims delivered verified_fix implemented verified or outcome_verified evidence or a candidate; the record and outcome always carry ReviewMode

scenarios.title: Build from a current design
scenarios.given: An implementation task names an approved design with unchanged source pins rules policy intent application snapshot and build scope before approval expiry
scenarios.when: Admission and each later gate evaluate the binding
scenarios.then: The packet and its existing approval sets are reused on the identical subject with no plan re-authoring invocation; the build retains oracle verification review and delivery gates

scenarios.title: Design drift reopens review
scenarios.given: A source pin rules bundle policy intent snapshot build scope review mode or approval expiry differs at binding or a later gate
scenarios.when: The binding is evaluated
scenarios.then: The chapter 19 replan path reopens exactly the affected sections and re-requests only the affected approval gates on a new subject; stale reuse and approvals moved to a changed packet are rejected; every assigned peer of a changed packet reconfirms

scenarios.title: Confidential and classified design
scenarios.given: A design task is embargoed or its sources carry restricted classification
scenarios.when: Review rendering delivery binding and export run
scenarios.then: Embargoed design stays human-reviewed and reaches only the task's private_fork/separate_repo publication target for its security group with provider-enforced reader checks, or a restricted report; a security-flagged unembargoed design stays human-reviewed under ordinary delivery; rendered content keeps the packet classification; only a task in the same security group may bind it, inheriting that embargo, and other-group or ungrouped builders are rejected

scenarios.title: Design budget and rules
scenarios.given: A design task runs under its design budget class with resolved rules and exceptions
scenarios.when: Spend or rule state changes
scenarios.then: Design spend is reserved and accounted separately from implementation budgets; exhaustion finishes incomplete without implementation; rules resolve before approval and exceptions keep their human approval

scenarios.title: Design storage isolation
scenarios.given: Design delivery and build-binding rows exist across organizations and security groups
scenarios.when: Cross-tenant writes retries scope toggles and bindings are attempted
scenarios.then: Forced tenant and task RLS append-only grants and tenant-qualified keys hold; a task cannot toggle into or out of design scope; a binding requires a visible design-scope source and a non-design builder with matching confidentiality

scenarios.title: Versioned design templates
scenarios.given: Human design templates 1.0.0 and ai-review design templates 2.0.0 are introduced
scenarios.when: Old workers or histories encounter design-delivery/1.0
scenarios.then: Compatible readers and explicit migrations precede enablement; existing journey templates and histories are unchanged; unknown profile or template fails closed; the ai-review design templates stay disabled until W-141 qualifies AI review

scenarios.title: Design task view and build action
scenarios.given: A user opens a design task or approved design
scenarios.when: The dashboard renders it
scenarios.then: The view shows journey review state approvals mode marker delivery target and design-only limitation without implemented or verified badges; Build from this design shows currency drift and affected approvals before creating a new linked task

scenarios.title: AI-reviewed design delivery
scenarios.given: An application has an in-force ai_only decision covering a non-security design task
scenarios.when: Design review delivery and later build binding run
scenarios.then: Unanimous qualified panels with every specialist supply intent architecture and plan gates on the exact subject; record outcome and design PR carry ReviewMode and the AI marker; embargoed or security-flagged designs stay human; lost AI authority makes a build re-request the affected approvals under human requirements
